facet_values_visibility_valid.name: facet_values_visibility_valid
facet_values_visibility_valid.value: visibility is null or visibility in ('hidden', 'discoverable', 'readable')

facet_values_exposure_valid.name: facet_values_exposure_valid
facet_values_exposure_valid.value: exposure is null or exposure in ('metadata-only', 'local-only', 'commercial-only', 'full')

grants_one_target.name: grants_one_target
grants_one_target.value:
(facet is not null and value is not null and object_id is null)
       or (facet is null and value is null and object_id is not null)

grants_expiry_after_creation.name: grants_expiry_after_creation
grants_expiry_after_creation.value: expires_at is null or expires_at > created_at

grants_revoked_after_creation.name: grants_revoked_after_creation
grants_revoked_after_creation.value: revoked_at is null or revoked_at >= created_at

grants_revocation_complete.name: grants_revocation_complete
grants_revocation_complete.value:
(revoked_at is null and revoked_by is null)
       or (revoked_at is not null and revoked_by is not null and revoked_by ~ '^[a-z]+:.+$')

groups_external_id_length.name: groups_external_id_length
groups_external_id_length.value: external_id is null or char_length(external_id) between 1 and 512

object_tags_applied_by_matches_source.name: object_tags_applied_by_matches_source
object_tags_applied_by_matches_source.value: applied_by is null or starts_with(applied_by, source || ':')

objects_display_title_length.name: objects_display_title_length
objects_display_title_length.value: display_title is null or char_length(display_title) between 1 and 1024

objects_display_title_has_author.name: objects_display_title_has_author
objects_display_title_has_author.value: display_title is null or display_title_by is not null

tag_reviews_applied_by_matches_source.name: tag_reviews_applied_by_matches_source
tag_reviews_applied_by_matches_source.value: applied_by is null or starts_with(applied_by, source || ':')

tag_reviews_resolution_complete.name: tag_reviews_resolution_complete
tag_reviews_resolution_complete.value:
(decision is null and resolved_by is null and resolved_at is null and merged_into is null)
       or (decision is not null and decision in ('approved', 'rejected', 'merged')
           and resolved_by is not null and resolved_by ~ '^[a-z]+:.+$'
           and resolved_at is not null and resolved_at >= created_at
           and (decision = 'merged') = (merged_into is not null))

users_external_id_unique.name: users_external_id_unique
users_external_id_unique.where: external_id is not null and retired_at is null

users_external_id_length.name: users_external_id_length
users_external_id_length.value: external_id is null or char_length(external_id) between 1 and 512

users_provider_disabled_by_scim.name: users_provider_disabled_by_scim
users_provider_disabled_by_scim.value: provider_disabled_by is null or (provider_disabled_by ~ '^scim:.+$' and source = 'scim')

versions_processed_after_creation.name: versions_processed_after_creation
versions_processed_after_creation.value: processed_at is null or processed_at >= created_at
